title: KODAK VISION3 shared image-dye set (family average of 50D/200T/250D/500T)
source: Traced from the Spectral Dye-Density chart of each stock's own datasheet (H-1-5203/5213/5207/5219, page 4, embedded raster ~250-260 dpi) by engine/ecn2/v3_dye_digitize.py; averaged by engine/ecn2/v3_basis_build.py
units: relative diffuse spectral density (Status M, D-min subtracted)
normalization: peak = 1.0 per dye (as the datasheet caption states)

replaces.reason: disagreed with a proper trace of its own stated source (250D) by RMSE 0.042 D cyan / 0.037 magenta / 0.012 yellow, max 0.197 D for cyan at 402 nm; it flattened cyan to 0.02 across 400-450 nm where the chart shows a real descender from ~0.21 D. That band carries 69.2% of Status M blue-channel weight.

support_note: Edge columns (<=3 nm at each frame edge) hold the terminal value -- a line-centring artifact, not absent data. Wider gaps stay null.  50D's printed curves end near 760 nm, so beyond that the average is over the three stocks that reach 800 nm; n_stocks_contributing records the count at every wavelength. Beyond those <=3 nm edge columns nothing is flat-held or zero-filled.

minimum_density.units: diffuse spectral density of the unexposed, processed film: base plus unreacted coloured coupler, absolute; family average of the four traced dashed Minimum Density curves
minimum_density.note: the mask the stock-blind ADX16 route reads the image dyes through (the roll anchor divides it out in integrated density) and the APD_Dmin term of ST 2065-3; a stock's own curve is in its own file

shared_dye_set_evidence.claim_it_tests: the datasheets' ~0.03 D agreement, previously checked only at 450/544/640 nm

audit.closure_caveat: non-negative C+M+Y vs the printed Midscale Neutral leaves RMS 0.06-0.08 D on all four stocks. A chart property, not a separation bias: the retired basis closes no better (0.060-0.072) with a worse maximum. Undiagnosed.
